title: Reference solution: Perform least-squares estimation
answer:
import numpy as np

A = np.array([[1.0, 1.0], [1.0, 2.0], [1.0, 3.0]])
y = np.array([2.0, 3.0, 5.0])
coef, residuals, rank, s = np.linalg.lstsq(A, y, rcond=None)
print(coef.round(3), rank)
